heading.title: Mac Mini M4
heading.subtitle: The always-on box: herdr server, four Codex seats, Bifrost, sleep prevented. Reachable right now over Tailscale (ssh answered at 20:43); the Cloudflare WARP private route is present but does not carry ping or ssh today. Every fact below carries the probe that produced it.

status.note: macOS 15.5 · Mac16,10 · 16 GB · load 1.15 · sleep prevented by powerd · herdr 0.6.5 · codex-cli 0.153.4 · Bifrost :8080 answers 200. The Mini clock reads 14:43 (its zone is one hour ahead of UTC; the laptop is +07).

routes.how: ssh -o BatchMode=yes mac-mini-ts returned hostname, sysctl, uptime; mini-herdr agent list returned 4 agents at 20:38. ESTATE.md calls Tailscale the legacy fallback; today it is the only route that carries traffic.

bin/mini-probe: "MINI unreachable: ping=fail warp_route=ok ssh=fail". Same verdict as estate/MINI-STATUS.md on 5 Sep. Pilot note: cloudflared runs on the Mini as a token-managed system daemon; the Mini's current interface address differs from the historical destination; origin certificate absent on both machines so advertised routes could not be inspected.

env -u HERDR_ENV -u HERDR_SESSION herdr --remote mac-mini-herdr --session default rendered the default-session UI (owner labels AGENCY, INTENT). First attempt inherited the laptop session name and started an empty named server, which was stopped; no owner runtime closed.
